Classic Interlude Devlog
Lineage II · Classic 2.5 client · Interlude server

Classic Interlude Devlog

The Classic Zaken client (protocol 110) running on an aCis Interlude server: the client gets the packets and windows it expects, while the gameplay stays Interlude. This page lists every change to the server, the client and the runtime, with the state of each feature.

Updated 2026-11-27 01:29 · history since 2026-09-01
~85%overall progress (approximate)

Weighted over 39 Interlude systems by size and by how far each has been tested on the Classic client (22 tested, 8 mostly, 6 partly, 2 with code but untested, 1 not checked). See the scorecard in Feature status. On the code side, 238 of 279 aCis server packets (85%) have a Classic path; many of the rest are replaced by Classic login packets, obsolete (version and anti-cheat checks) or GM-only views.

Friday 27 November 2026 6 changes

  • Maps & zonesDimensional Rift map

    The Map window showed nothing inside the Dimensional Rift: no client has a map of it. It now shows the Rift's rooms, cut from a top-down picture whose layout matches our client's.

    More in the change log
  • GM toolsDashboard map: NPC panel

    A click on an NPC opens a panel like the player one: name, title, level, type, HP or dead, NPC and object id, location, map square and place, with Locate and Track.

    More in the change log
  • GM toolsGM speed 6 and saved GM switches

    GMs get a sixth GM speed, twice speed 5, with its buff icon and //gmspeed 6; a GM still logs in at speed 5. The Admin tab's on/off pairs (fall damage, weight limit, world chat, captcha) are now single switches that show their state and keep it after logging out and after a restart.

  • OlympiadEvery colosseum visitable

    The GM teleport page lists the Olympiad's real arenas, plus the Classic map's four colosseum styles (redesigned, Hero's Trail, redesigned underground and the Classic colosseum).

  • Maps & zonesClassic places at a click

    GM Teleport > Other Location > Classic Locations gathers the places only the Classic map has; the game server's memory is trimmed by loading geodata only where needed, and a dashboard Memory page shows where the RAM goes.

  • Client UIRandom loading and start-up pictures

    Each load shows one of 27 loading pictures, and the start-up screen one of the 5 alternative Classic pictures.

  • Maps & zonesProvisional Clan Hall titles

    Entering a hall shows its own name on one line, e.g. "Provisional Clan Hall - Ellia 2".

  • Maps & zonesFantasy Isle's beaches open

    Players ran in place at the island's shore: the Classic map rings Fantasy Isle with 13 invisible walls, from just above the sea floor up into the sky. They are gone, so the beaches and the sea can be reached from the golf course and the rest of the island; rocks and buildings still block as before, and the Underground Coliseum below is untouched.

    More in the change log
  • GM toolsDashboard map: territory hover switch

    A button on the dashboard map turns the territory highlight on mouse-over off and on; a click still keeps a territory selected, and the browser remembers the choice.

    More in the change log

Thursday 26 November 2026 36 changes

  • Maps & zonesA Scroll of Escape keeps you in your Provisional Clan Hall

    Each of the nine Provisional Clan Halls (Orchid, Ellia and Laurell 1 to 3) is now an area of its own, and a Scroll of Escape to the nearest town used inside one brings you back to that hall's arrival spot; scrolls to a named town, castle or clan hall work as before.

    More in the change log
  • GM toolsServer dashboard: a live map for GMs

    The dashboard map now shows which geodata map squares the server has loaded and the memory each takes, over a sharper Interlude world map with Fantasy Isle drawn in. A click keeps a territory selected; a click on a player opens their panel (place, map square, race, class, clan, time online) with Locate and Track, which keeps the map on them as they move; Ctrl+click gives the world coordinates of any spot.

    More in the change logalso 1bdaa46 e245542 625f333 962c7c6
  • Maps & zonesFantasy Isle, Underground Coliseum and Provisional Clan Halls named

    These three places read "Neutral Waterways" on the Classic client: its place-name map leaves their map squares blank. The Classic 2.1 client draws them in a file our client lacks; its outlines are copied in and the places now carry their names, in game and in the server's reports.

    More in the change logalso 49d8d4d

Wednesday 25 November 2026 39 changes

  • Maps & zonesGoddard's holy room altars

    The Altar of Fire and the Altar of Water floated in Goddard Castle's holy room: Classic's map asked for a pedestal no client has. The pedestals are back, lit like the room, and both altars now stand centred on them; //npcdraw lets a GM place where the Classic client draws an NPC.

    More in the change logalso 10b1d41 7835f9c dec4e5c 420194c 8e1621a
  • Maps & zonesRune library entrance

    A remade Classic bookcase stood shifted and floating in the Rune library's doorway; Rune town is drawn with Interlude's models again and the bookcase stands centred on the floor.

    More in the change logalso cde696a
  • Maps & zonesPrimeval Isle rocks, Dragon Valley bridges, Mithril Mines

    Classic's remakes of these models did not fit the Interlude maps (streaked rocks, sunken bridges, broken mine walls); they use Interlude's models and textures now.

    More in the change logalso e1948e9 6c151dd 74c67eb
  • Maps & zonesFantasy Isle and the provisional clan halls walkable

    The Classic client draws 32 map squares Interlude never had (Fantasy Isle, the Orchid, Ellia and Laurell provisional clan halls...); the server had no ground for them and nobody could move there. Their geodata now comes from a Classic geodata pack, matched against the client maps.

    More in the change log
  • Maps & zonesDevastated Castle named

    Most of Devastated Castle read Fields of Massacre on the Classic client; the whole castle, as the server outlines it, now reads Devastated Castle.

    More in the change logalso 73cea86
  • Maps & zonesNo more "Frontier"

    The Classic client named 21 places "Frontier" (Goddard Castle, the Valley of Saints, Wall of Argos, Ketra Orc Outpost, Hot Springs, Rune Harbor...); they now carry their Interlude names.

    More in the change logalso 95ff0c3
  • GM toolsGMs enter hidden and fast

    A GM now logs in hidden with GM speed 5, with a message for each; on the Classic client GMs were never set up at login (no hide, no GM list, no bot report notice), which is fixed too.

    More in the change logalso 19c609e

What these numbers cannot tell

  • Tests are recorded per game system, not per packet, so there is no count of tested packets.
  • The client's request table (read from its send code) has a few wrong sub-opcodes, so a request also counts as routed when the server creates it by name; every unrouted request was then judged by hand.
  • 343 quests run on the server; the quest journal, markers and a handful of quests were played through on this client, most quests were not.
  • Gameplay rules are aCis's (the Interlude reference) and are not scored: this page measures whether each system works through the Classic client.

Everything the project adds to Interlude: Classic client features and project extras. Most have a switch in the server's config/classic_features.properties; the value shown is the default the server ships with.

Classic features and their switches 93 switches

Daily missions1
DailyMissions
True
The Daily Mission window: missions per class, their rewards and the level rewards (data/xml/dailyMissions.xml). False: the window stays empty and no mission progresses. Related: the missions, their rewards and the level rewards are edited in data/xml/dailyMissions.xml.
Mail6

The Classic mailbox reads and sends the community board's mail. These settings cover what Classic adds to it. Related: the community board's own mail has no settings of its own.

MailAttachments
True
Items attached to a letter, and payment requests (the receiver pays adena to take the items). False: letters carry text only.
MailPostage
100
Adena charged for sending a letter, and for each attached item.
MailPostagePerItem
1000
MailExpiryDays
15
Days before an unclaimed attachment returns to its sender.
MailPaymentExpiryHours
12
Hours the receiver has to pay a payment request before the items go back.
MailContacts
100
Size of the mail contact list.
Fishing1
FishingMode
AUTO
How a hooked fish is fought. INTERLUDE: the Interlude minigame. The player pumps and reels with the Pumping and Reeling skills while the fishing window shows the fish's HP, the time left and its mood. A protocol-110 client needs the patched client (Engine.dll, Interface.u) that brings that window back. AUTO: no minigame. Once a fish bites, the server fights it with the player's own Pumping and Reeling skills (their power, MP cost and reuse, the rod grade and fish shots count as usual), so the catch chances stay aCis's. On a protocol-110 client the Classic automatic fishing button starts it and casts again after every catch while bait is left. Both modes show the fishing window with its 3D view and Results button on a protocol-110 client. Related: the rest of the fishing settings are Interlude's: the Fishing Tournament (AllowFishChampionship and its rewards) in events.properties; the fish in data/xml/fish.xml; the lures, rods and shots in data/xml/items and the Fishing Guild's shop in data/xml/buyLists.xml. The rules and chances are in the server repository's docs/FISHING_GUIDE.md. //fishcam tunes the 3D view's camera until a restart.
Shots1
AutoShots
True
Automatic soulshots and spiritshots. The Classic client shows them in their own four slots above the shortcut bar (soulshot, spiritshot, beast soulshot, beast spiritshot); the automatic use itself is Interlude's. False: shots are used only by hand (both protocols). Related: Interlude has no shot settings of its own; the shots are items in data/xml/items.
Adena distribution2
AdenaDistribution
True
The Distribution button of the party and command channel windows: the party leader (or the command channel's leader) shares an amount of adena equally between the members in range. Related: PartyRange in players.properties is Interlude's party range for XP and drops, not this one.
AdenaDistributionRange
1500
Members farther from the leader than this get nothing.
PC Cafe points5
PcCafePoints
False
PC Cafe points: earned while online, spent in multisells that ask for them (ingredient id="65436" in data/multisell; a product with that id gives points). The Classic client shows the total in those multisells; its PC Cafe point window is hidden on a Classic server. Related: what the points buy is set in the multisells, data/xml/multisell.
PcCafeInterval
10
Every PcCafeInterval minutes online, a character earns PcCafePointsPerInterval points, doubled with PcCafeDoubleChance percent chance. A character never holds more than PcCafeMaxPoints.
PcCafePointsPerInterval
10
PcCafeDoubleChance
10
PcCafeMaxPoints
200000
Clan1
LargeClanCrest
True
The large clan crest (clan mark) of the clan window, uploaded by the leader of a level 3+ clan. Related: Interlude's clan rules (join, create, dissolve, alliance) are in clans.properties.
Interface5
CancelBuffs
True
Cancel one's own buffs (and the summon's) from the buff bar.
SaveKeyBindings
True
Keep the key bindings on the server, so they follow the character to any computer.
ShowRaidPoints
True
Show the character's raid points in the status window.
ChatItemLinks
True
Show an item's details when a link to it in chat is clicked.
WhisperSenderLevel
True
Show the sender's level with a whisper.
World chat (&), protocol 11071
WorldChatEnabled
True
A line every player online reads: in the client's world chat box when the player shows it (Options > Chat Common > Use World Chat Window), else in the chat window. A GM turns it on and off with //worldchat on|off until the restart.
WorldChatSenders
BOTH
Who may send: BOTH, PLAYERS or GM. WorldChatGmAlways lets a GM send whatever WorldChatSenders says.
WorldChatGmAlways
True
WorldChatMinLevel
20
A player (not a GM) also needs this level...
WorldChatNoblesse
False
...and to belong to at least one of these categories set to True (any one is enough). With Female and Male True (the default) every player may; set both False to open world chat to the other categories only. Newbie: no class change yet. FirstClass / SecondClass / ThirdClass: that class change done (a second class has done the first too). Karma: karma above 0. EpicJewels: wears one of WorldChatEpicJewelIds. WeaponEnchant: holds a weapon of WorldChatWeaponEnchantLevel or more.
WorldChatHero
False
WorldChatNewbie
False
WorldChatFirstClass
False
WorldChatSecondClass
False
WorldChatThirdClass
False
WorldChatKarma
False
WorldChatEpicJewels
False
WorldChatWeaponEnchant
False
WorldChatFemale
True
WorldChatMale
True
WorldChatEpicJewelIds
6656,6657,6658,6659,6660,8191
Antharas, Valakas, Baium, Zaken, Queen Ant, Frintezza.
WorldChatWeaponEnchantLevel
16
WorldChatPointsPerDay
10
Lines a player may send a day (0: no limit), counted from 06:30 as on Classic; the client's world chat box shows what is left. Seconds between two lines (0: none). GMs have no limit.
WorldChatInterval
20
WorldChatLinkedChannels
 
Chat channels whose lines are also said in world chat, comma separated (empty: none), e.g. TRADE or TRADE,SHOUT. Names: ALL, SHOUT, TRADE, HERO_VOICE, PARTY, CLAN, ALLIANCE.
WorldInfoQuests
True
World Info: the quests the character can start, and the raid bosses alive or dead.
WorldInfoRaids
True
ShopPurchaseMessages
True
Tell the buyer what an NPC shop purchase cost and gave (both protocols).
BotReport
True
The Report Bot action (/AutoHuntingReport): reports are kept (table bot_reports, also log/botreports.txt) until a GM archives and deletes them on the Bot Reports board (//botreports); the GMs online are told of each new one. A player may report the same character again after BotReportReuse minutes.
BotReportReuse
30
BotReportLargePages
True
The Bot Reports board shows three reports a page, which needs board pages larger than Interlude's (up to 24,540 characters instead of 12,270; the protocol 110 client takes them). False goes back to Interlude's size, and a page then holds as many reports as fit (two).
KeyboardMovement
True
Move with the W and S keys (the client's keyboard movement). Interlude (aCis) refuses movement requests coming from the keyboard; False keeps that rule, and only turning (A/D) works.
QuestItemsApart
True
Quest items do not count against the inventory limit, as the protocol 110 client shows it ("77/80" next to a separate Quest Items tab). Interlude counts every item, quest items too: False keeps that rule. Related: the inventory sizes (MaximumSlotsForNoDwarf / ForDwarf) are in players.properties.
CharacterPin
False
Character PIN, as on official servers: one PIN per account (6 to 8 digits), registered and then asked at the character selection before a character enters the game or is deleted; five wrong PINs block the account for eight hours, and a GM removes a PIN with //resetpin <account>. The client asks the server whatever this says (l2.ini [Auth] UseSecondaryAuth=true); with False the server lets every character in without a PIN.
PartyPets
True
Party window: the other members' pets and servitors under their names, with HP and MP (ExPartyPetWindow). Interlude had no such window: only the owner saw his summon.
NewSkillNotice
True
After a level-up, the skill window's notice that the trainer has new skills (ExNewSkillToLearnByLevelUp), when a skill unlocked by the new level is waiting to be learned.
MpccLootRule
True
Command channel window: the loot rule turns from "General" to "Loot Leader" while the channel holds a raid boss's loot rights (enough members attacking it first), and back when they lapse (ExSetMpccRouting). Related: raid boss loot and auto loot (AutoLootRaid) are in server.properties.
GmViewWindows
True
The GM window (Alt+G) shows a player's inventory, skills, warehouse, dyes, quests and clan in the client's own windows (GMView* packets in their protocol 110 layouts). Its status tab still needs //charinfo.
ScreenTimer
True
On-screen countdown (AITimerWnd, ExSendUIEvent): the time left of castle and clan hall sieges for their participants, of Olympiad fights for the fighters and spectators, and //timer <seconds> [caption] for events. Related: the siege length and rules are in siege.properties, the Olympiad's in events.properties.
NewsPage
True
In-game news page: at login the client opens its browser window on l2.ini [URL] L2InGameBrowserNoticeURL, which should point here (http://<your server address>:<NewsPagePort>/news). The game server serves data/html/news/index.htm (edit it any time; %char_name% is the character). The page has a "Do not show again today" link.
NewsPagePort
8081
The port of the news page (open it in the firewall for players). Related: the page itself is data/html/news/index.htm; the client's address for it is l2.ini [URL].
Coupons
True
Coupon codes: the Adventurer Guildsmen open the coupon window ("Enter a coupon code"); the codes and their rewards are in data/xml/coupons.xml (read again at every use), and table coupon_uses keeps who used which. Related: the codes and rewards are edited in data/xml/coupons.xml.
ItemDelivery
True
Item delivery box: items waiting for a character (//deliver <character> <itemId> [count], or rows written to table delivered_items by an event or a web shop), taken from the window the Adventurer Guildsmen open ("Collect delivered items"). A notice shows at login while anything waits.
BotCaptcha
True
Anti-bot check (BOTsystemWnd): a six-digit number drawn over noise that the player types on a shuffled keypad. A GM starts it with //captcha [character] (or the target), //captcha all for everyone; //captcha on|off|status, also on the admin window's Server tab, switches it at run time until the next restart. This switch is the startup value.
BotCaptchaTime
60
Seconds to answer (the window counts them down), at least 10.
BotCaptchaTries
3
Wrong answers allowed; each one draws a new number.
BotCaptchaPenalty
KICK
When the time or the attempts run out: KICK (back to the login screen) or JAIL.
BotCaptchaJailMinutes
60
Jail length in minutes for BotCaptchaPenalty = JAIL (0: until a GM releases the player).
BotCaptchaAutoMinutes
0
Automatic checks: every non-GM character gets one after this many minutes online (counted from the login, and again from each check passed). 0: off, only GMs start checks.
BotCaptchaAutoRandomMinutes
0
Random spread of the automatic check, in minutes either way: 120 with 30 gives a check between 90 and 150 minutes.
NpcMoveSourceDatapack
 
//npcmove: target an NPC, stand where it should be and type //npcmove; it moves there (facing your way) and its pos is rewritten in data/xml/spawnlist. Also rewrite it in this datapack folder (the source the deploy copies from, so the next deploy keeps the move); empty: only the server's own datapack.
MonsterInfo
All
Monster Info: shift+click on a monster or a raid boss, or the button of the target window (patched client), opens its info in the Community Board (title Monster Info, a smaller window): name, level, XP and SP, Aggressive or Passive, a Rates button (the data's own numbers or the server's rates) and the tabs (Drops, Spoil, Herbs, Skills, Locations and XP / SP, the reward by the player's level; MonsterInfoXpSp switches the header's XP and SP and that tab). Each switch: All (every player), GM (game masters only) or None.
MonsterInfoXpSp
All
The parts of the page. The Rates button (x1 or the server's rates): whoever it is not shown to sees the server's rates.
MonsterInfoAggression
All
MonsterInfoRates
GM
MonsterInfoDrops
All
Related: the server's rates the Rates button shows are Rate* in server.properties; the monsters' data is data/xml/npcs. The tabs.
MonsterInfoSpoil
All
MonsterInfoHerbs
All
MonsterInfoSkills
All
MonsterInfoLocations
All
Attendance
True
Daily login calendar: one reward a day, from the main menu ("Attendance Check"). Its rewards and rules (reset time, online time, level, per account or per character, looping) are EventAttendance_* in events.properties.
TitleColor
True
Title colour window: the Color Title item (13021, a placeholder with no source yet: //create_item or //deliver) opens it; the player picks one of ten colours and a title. The colour is kept across logins.
ClanEntry
True
Clan Entry window (main menu, clan window): the clan recruitment board, applications and the waiting list of clanless players. Accepted players join the main clan; entries are dropped after 30 days. Related: Interlude's rules for joining a clan (DaysBeforeJoinAClan...) still apply: clans.properties.
ClanWarCancelPenalty
True
End War (clan window, Clan War Status): the clan that ends a war it declared loses 500 Clan Reputation. The player first sees "If you cancel a declared war, you will lose 500 Clan Reputation. Proceed?". False: no reputation is taken and no warning shows; the war ends at once. Protocol 110 only.
ClientCollisionRadius
0
Stairs: the collision radius protocol 110 clients get for players on foot (their own and others'). The client keeps a character at a step's height while any part of its collision cylinder is over the step, so with the class radius (about 9) a character beside stairs stands a step up in the air. The client also sizes weapons by this radius (radius 4 drew them at two thirds), so since 2026-11-12 the client itself narrows the cylinder to 4 on foot and keeps weapons at the real size (Engine.dll patch_attach_scale.py): leave this at 0 (the class radius) with that client. A value here shrinks the radius the client sees, weapons included. 0 = the class radius.
CameraZoom
False
Camera zoom limits for every protocol 110 player (needs the client's Engine.dll patch_camera_zoom.py). False = the client's own limits. The numbers are the client's zoom values: the camera stands about value + 250 from the character. The client's own: the mouse wheel -200 to 253 (User.ini: MinZoomingDist -200, the normal camera's distance 230 x 1.1), the zoom keys -200 to 1000. GMs can try other values live with //camerazoom (only on their own client) and save them here from that window.
CameraZoomMin
-200
CameraZoomMax
253
AdminShutdownSeconds
60
Server Management (//manage), Admin tab: the countdowns of its Shutdown, Restart and Shutdown all buttons, in seconds. The tab saves a new value here when a GM types one; Shutdown all stops the login server too, once the game server has left it.
AdminRestartSeconds
60
AdminFullShutdownSeconds
60
DamageTextRegeneration
True
Damage text: protocol 110 players see their own natural regeneration as Recover HP / Recover MP numbers (every 3 s while not full; the client's Options > Damage Text > Player > Recover HP / MP must be on). False = only heals show numbers.
CriticalHeals
False
Critical heals (a Classic mechanic Interlude does not have: there, a heal never crits). True = a heal skill (Heal, Battle Heal, Group Heal, percent heals... not potions or item heals) can land critically: the chance is the healer's magic critical rate, the amount is multiplied by CriticalHealMultiplier (Classic: 3). The healer sees "Magic critical hit!" and a "Critical" label over the healed character (client Options > Damage Text > Recovery Target > Crit. rate).
CriticalHealMultiplier
3.0
FantasyIsle
False
Fantasy Isle and the Underground Coliseum (protocol 110), each on or off apart; off saves the server's memory. FantasyIsle loads the island's geodata: map squares 17_15, 18_15, 18_16 and the surface of 17_16 (about 15 MB). UndergroundColiseum loads the Coliseum's geodata, under 17_16 (below z -5000, about 17 MB). Square 17_16 then loads whole (both on), as data/geodata/17_16_island_conv.dat or 17_16_coliseum_conv.dat (one on), or not at all. The squares must also be listed in geoengine.properties. Takes effect after a restart. The client's maps always show the island, whatever these say (a client cannot follow a server switch without a launcher; client tools/fantasy_isle_maps.py on|off can swap its maps by hand).
UndergroundColiseum
False

Events and other added settings

Server dashboard APIdashboard.properties · 5

A small read-only HTTP API for the server dashboard (dashboard/ in the server repository: a Docker container that shows the page). It answers with JSON from the server's memory: players, zones, stores, castles, bosses, olympiad, seven signs, manor, counters, performance and the log. No database access (no database password is involved).

DashboardEnabled
False
True opens the API at the next start.
DashboardHost
[IP removed]
Where it listens. [IP removed]: this PC only (Docker Desktop reaches it through host.docker.internal). Do not open it to the internet: it shows players' IP addresses.
DashboardPort
7790
DashboardToken
 
The shared secret: every API call must send it (header X-Dashboard-Token). At least 12 characters; put the same value in dashboard/.env (DASHBOARD_TOKEN). An empty or short token keeps the API off.
DashboardPingSeconds
15
How often (seconds, 5 or more) every protocol 110 player is pinged for the latency column.
Attendance (protocol 110 only)events.properties · 8

The daily login calendar (main menu > Attendance Check). Switched on and off by Attendance in classic_features.properties. Changes need a server restart.

EventAttendance_ResetTime
06:30
Time of day a new attendance day starts (HH:mm, server time).
EventAttendance_Reward
57-10000;1539-5;736-3;57-20000;1539-10;736-5;57-100000;57-10000;1539-5;736-3;57-20000;1539-10;736-5;57-200000;57-10000;1539-5;736-3;57-20000;1539-10;736-5;57-300000;57-10000;1539-5;736-3;57-20000;1539-10;736-5;57-500000
The reward of each day, in order: itemId-count;itemId-count;... Up to 28 days (four rows of seven): fill 7, 14, 21 or 28 days, the window is laid out in whole rows.
EventAttendance_InGameTime
30
Minutes online needed before today's reward can be taken, added up over the day's logins (a logout keeps what was spent; per account or per character, as EventAttendance_Global; a restart of the server keeps it: table attendance_online, written every minute). 0: at once.
EventAttendance_Highlights
7, 14, 21, 28
Days whose slot is highlighted (comma separated).
EventAttendance_OnEnter
True
Open the calendar by itself at login while today's reward waits.
EventAttendance_Looped
True
After the last day: True starts again from day 1 the next day; False ends the calendar.
EventAttendance_Global
True
True: one calendar per account, a day is taken by whichever character claims it first. False: every character has its own calendar.
EventAttendance_MinLevel
1
Minimum level to take a reward (the calendar still opens and says the level needed).
Change of Heart (event)events.properties · 9

Sprockets the Cat (NPC 50003, Beryl the Cat's model) plays rock-paper-scissors with players who bring one of each of the nine "Change of Heart" heart pieces (items 4209-4217), which drop from monsters all over the world while the event runs. Each win raises the prize; the player may stop and take it after any win; a loss ends the game with the prize one step lower (a loss without a win: the consolation prize). Eight wins end the game with the top prize. //changeofheart start | stop | auto (GM) overrides the settings below until the next restart.

ChangeOfHeart
False
True: the event runs all the time (ignores the dates below).
ChangeOfHeartStart
 
Or a period, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" server time (both empty: no period). Heart pieces drop from ChangeOfHeartStart to ChangeOfHeartEnd; Sprockets stays until ChangeOfHeartNpcEnd (empty: until ChangeOfHeartEnd), so pieces can be traded after the drops stop, as in the original event (drops 14-18 February, cat until 27 February).
ChangeOfHeartEnd
 
ChangeOfHeartNpcEnd
 
ChangeOfHeartDropChance
1.0
Chance (percent) that a killed monster drops one heart piece (which of the nine: random).
ChangeOfHeartMaxLevelDiff
9
No piece from a monster more than this many levels below the killer (0: no limit).
ChangeOfHeartPrizes
1539-10;1538-1;3936-1;951-2;948-4;947-1;730-3;729-1
Prizes for 1 to 8 wins in a row. Format: itemId-count;itemId-count... (one per win count, in order). Default: 10 Greater Healing Potion; Blessed Scroll of Escape; Blessed Scroll of Resurrection; 2 Enchant Weapon (C); 4 Enchant Armor (B); Enchant Weapon (B); 3 Enchant Armor (A); Enchant Weapon (A).
ChangeOfHeartConsolation
57-10000

NPC ids a player can talk to only with the NPC in sight (geodata line of sight), at any distance. Others need sight only from farther than 100: the geodata draws a railing as a wall, so a sight check for every NPC made the ones behind railings and counters (warehouses) unreachable. List NPCs that can be talked to through a thin wall and have nothing like a railing before them; check first with //geo see from their normal talking spot (it must say "Line of sight: yes"). Separated by commas, empty for none. Default: 30002,30004 (Talking Island's Jackson and Katerina).

GM commands added 61

CommandParametersWhat it does
//gmshopbbsOpen the GM Shop on the community board.
//gmshopbbs_cat[index]Open or close a category on the board GM Shop.
//gmshopbbs_grp[index]Show a grade of the open board GM Shop category.
//gmshopbbs_all[index]Open every item of a GM Shop category in one shop, by grade.
//itemsearchOpen the item search on the community board.
//itemsearch_homeItem search: back to every item, no search, no filter.
//itemsearch_find[name|id]Item search: search with the pressed filters.
//itemsearch_filter[g grade|k type]Item search: press or release a filter.
//itemsearch_clearItem search: release every filter.
//itemsearch_amount[count]Item search: set the amount Buy and Give hand out.
//itemsearch_page[page]Item search: show a page.
//itemsearch_jump[page]Item search: go to a page, counted from 1.
//itemsearch_buy[id] [count]Item search: give yourself an item.
//itemsearch_give[id] [count]Item search: give your targeted player an item.
//itemsearch_classicItem search: switch to the items only the Classic client has, and back.
//itemsearch_pickedItem search: the Picked items tab (the picked Classic items, made server items by tools/classic_picks.py), and back.
//itemsearch_category[category]Item search: press or release a category button (Classic items and Picked items tabs).
//itemsearch_info[id]Item search: everything the client knows about a Classic item.
//itemsearch_pick[id]Item search: pick or drop a Classic item (data/classic_item_picks.txt).
//changeofheart[start|stop|auto|here]Change of Heart event: start or stop it now, or back to events.properties (auto); here: move the targeted or nearest Sprockets to where you stand and save it; no parameter shows its state.
//screen[text]Show a message in the middle of every player's screen for 5 seconds.
//useralert[add|say|set|send|test|toggle|del]Protocol 110: the admin messages of the alert bar above the chat window.
//setclass[classId]Set the target's class; without an id, show the class board.
//classtree[baseClassId]Protocol 110: class selection tree of a base class on the community board.
//falldamage[on|off]Turn your own fall damage on or off (no argument toggles; kept on your character).
//worldchat[on|off]Turn protocol 110 world chat (&) on or off; kept after a restart (classic_features.properties WorldChatEnabled).
//monrace[startsales|endsales|startrace|endrace|stop|go|speeds|track]Open the Monster Race window: race state, lanes with bets, odds and speeds; start or end the ticket sales or the race, stop the clock, new speeds, go to the track.
//ratetestOpen the rate test window: roll item or skill enchants 1 to 10000 times and compare the real success rate with the expected one.
//botreports[active|important|archived] [page]Open the Bot Reports board.
//manageOpen the Community Board as Server Management (protocol 110): tabs Online, Petitions, Bot Reports, Shop Board, Item Srch and Admin; opens on Admin.
//gmtools[shutdown|restart|all seconds|abort]Admin tab of Server Management (protocol 110): shutdown, restart, shutdown all (game then login server) with saved countdowns, two presses each; GM tools and every project command as buttons with tooltips.
//playmovie[movie id]Play a client movie full screen on your own client (protocol 110; UsmMovieData-eu.dat ids, 149 = quest 127's Kamael slideshow, the default). A GM gets the movie's GM copy (id + 1000), which Esc stops; players cannot stop movies.
//resetquest&lt;quest id or name&gt; [character]Forget a quest, started or completed, for the character, your target or yourself, so it can be taken again (progress and quest items removed, rewards kept).
//ppl[online|offline|race name|class name|lvl|ip|search text|clear|page n|tp name]Player list of the Server Management board (protocol 110): online or offline characters, filters and teleport.
//resetpin[account]Remove an account's character PIN (or the targeted player's).
//timerseconds [caption]Show a countdown on every player's screen (0 hides it).
//delivercharacter itemId [count]Put an item in a character's delivery box (taken at the Adventurer Guildsmen).
//captcha[character|all|on|off|status]Anti-bot check (protocol 110): show it to a character, the target or every non-GM character, or switch it on/off (kept after a restart: classic_features.properties BotCaptcha).
//loadhtmlfileShow a page of data/html (the GM tool window's HTML tab).
//boardtestShow data/html/boardtest.htm on the board, again on each change of the file; again to stop (a layout bench).
//fishcam[setting value]Show or change the protocol 110 fishing window 3D view settings until restart (the next cast uses them).
//create_itemitemId [count]Same as //give (the usual l2j name).
//killnpcSame as //kill (the GM tool window's KillNpc).
//set_skill_all_meGive yourself every skill of your class and level.
//skill_master[on|off]Official command with no counterpart here: says so.
//item_master[on|off]Official command with no counterpart here: says so.
//npc_use_skillskillId [level]The targeted NPC casts the skill (highest level) on its target or itself.
//come_to_meThe targeted NPC walks to you.
//setai[default_npc]The targeted NPC forgets its hate and goes home.
//setparamlv|exp|karma|sex|... valueOfficial name of //set (lv = level; race follows the class here).
//weight[off|on]Your weight limit off (no weight penalty) or back on; kept on your character.
//effectsSend your buff icons again (after the GM tool window's TestEvent).
//botreportask tpr|tps|jailr|jails|kickr|kicks|banr|bans|thanks|important|check|pending|archive|restore|delete id [view page]Ask to confirm an action on a bot report, from the Bot Reports board.
//banipip|name [reason]Ban an IP (or the IP of a player online) from the game server at once, kicking who plays from it.
//unbanipipLift a game server IP ban.
//banipsList the game server IP bans.
//tryskell[buffer command]Use the Tryskell scheme buffer (npc 50002) without spawning it.
//npcmoveMove the targeted NPC to where you stand (facing your way) and save it in its spawn file.
//npcdraw[dx dy dz|here|reset|save]Move where the protocol 110 client draws the targeted NPC (not the NPC); save keeps it.
//talkscan[scan|page p|go id|add id|skip id]Window of NPCs a player may talk to through a wall (spots within 100 out of sight): go there, add to NpcTalkNeedsSight or skip.
//camerazoom[try min max|default|saved|save min max|off]Camera zoom limits window: try values on your own client, save them for everyone (classic_features.properties CameraZoom).

Client-side additions

Changes in the client files, with no server switch: they come with the client.

  • The 3D character view in the inventory, and the animated or still "N" mark on new items.
  • The World Info map tables: zone names, regions, raid bosses, hunting grounds.
  • Quest head markers, and Interlude wording for the system messages.
  • Engine and window patches: the fishing window and its 3D view, camera zoom limits from the server, keyboard walking fixes, the lift camera, text boxes that start filled in, and more (listed in the change log under Client).
